description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 §3.

Spec text: "sha256: a String. Lowercase hex, exactly 64 chars. ABNF: 64( %x30-39 / %x61-66 )."

## Acceptance

- New type Sha256Digest in crate-jmap-cid-types/src/digest.rs
- Newtype wrapping String with the ABNF validation
- Constructors:
  - `Sha256Digest::from_hex(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Sha256DigestError>` — validates length and lowercase-hex
  - `Sha256Digest::from_bytes(b: &[u8; 32]) -> Self` — formats a 32-byte digest to lowercase hex (infallible)
- Serialize/Deserialize round-trips as the bare hex string (NOT a wrapped object)
- Deserialize rejects: wrong length, uppercase chars, non-hex chars
- impl Display, AsRef<str>
- Error type `Sha256DigestError { kind: enum Kind { WrongLength { got: usize }, NonHexLowercase { at: usize } } }`
- Unit tests:
  - Round-trip: valid 64-char lowercase hex preserves bit-for-bit
  - Reject upper-case hex
  - Reject 63 chars, 65 chars, 0 chars
  - Reject any non-hex character (e.g. 'g')
  - from_bytes([0xde, 0xad, ..]) produces "deadbeef..." formatted output
- Extras-policy aware: this is a primitive value type (not an object), so no `extra` field; matches jmap-types::Id precedent

## Out of scope

- The Blob/FileNode-side fields that USE Sha256Digest (D.3)
- Capability detection (D.4)
- crypto::sha2 computation helper — kept out of the type crate (no crypto deps; consumer computes)
title: Layer D: Define Sha256Digest typed shape in jmap-cid-types
